info.name: Digital Banking Microservices
info.description: End-to-end tests for account, transaction, payment, fraud-detection, notification services and the API gateway. Run folders in order. Folder 4 needs the `otp` environment variable (see request description).

item.name: Create account - invalid email + negative deposit

exec: pm.test("Has id and createdAt", () => { pm.expect(b.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.createdAt).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test("Balance not reduced by a negative credit", () => pm.expect(Number(r.text())).to.eql(5000)));
pm.test("Type TRANSFER with reference number", () => { pm.expect(b.type).to.eql('TRANSFER'); pm.expect(b.referenceNumber).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Get transaction - completed after fraud check

exec: pm.test("Receiver history shows the incoming transfer", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(t => t.id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('txClean')));
pm.test("Sender not charged for a transfer to a non-existent account", () => pm.expect(Number(r.text())).to.eql(pm.environment.get('senderBefore')))), 6000);

request.description: Set the `otp` environment variable first: copy it from the notification-service console ("Your OTP is: ...") or run `redis-cli GET verification:otp<txFraud>`.

item.name: 5. OTP verify - wrong OTP blocks account

exec: pm.test("Failure reason mentions wrong OTP + refund", () => { pm.expect(b.failureReason).to.include('Wrong OTP'); pm.expect(b.failureReason).to.include('refunded'); });

item.name: Verify OTP on an already-COMPLETED transaction

exec: pm.test("Sender not refunded a second time", () => pm.expect(Number(r.text())).to.eql(pm.environment.get('senderBefore'))));
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ senderAccountNumber: pm.environment.get('receiverAcc'), receiverAccountNumber: pm.environment.get('senderAcc'), amount: 10 }) } },

request.description: Needs real Razorpay test keys (razorpay.key-id / key-secret).

exec: for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) pm.sendRequest(pm.environment.replaceIn('{{gatewayUrl}}/api/v1/accounts/{{senderAcc}}/balance'), (e, r) => { codes.push(r ? r.code : 0); if (++done === 30) pm.environment.set('burstCodes', JSON.stringify(codes)); });
pm.test("Some burst requests throttled with 429", () => pm.expect(codes.filter(c => c === 429).length).to.be.above(0));

item.name: Internal credit endpoint not exposed via gateway

exec: pm.test("Public gateway blocks internal balance mutation (401/403/404)", () => pm.expect([401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
